title: aiprov: domain-agnostic AI provenance over PROV-O

creators.name: Krebs, Florian
creators.affiliation: DLR Institute of Structures and Design, ZLP Augsburg

description:
aiprov records who, a person or an AI model, did what to an artefact and who checked it, in a plain Turtle file as a profile of W3C PROV-O. It provides the vocabulary (https://w3id.org/aiprov/ns#), the provlog command line (activities with the telemetry the tool reports; claims on a seven-step verification ladder whose top two steps only registered humans may grant; validate, report, merge for multi-agent runs) and a dashboard builder.

A demo graph, explained: https://noheton.github.io/aiprov/
notes: Developed with AI assistance (Anthropic Claude models, named in the commit trailers). Every AI-assisted change is recorded in the repository's own provenance graph (provenance.ttl), which CI validates.
